excludedInitialRuns.limits: Preserved failed evidence only. Its report, verdict and observations are not accepted review evidence or reconciliation inputs.

representation: Reports, prompts and receipts are byte-exact. Published chain segments are losslessly gzipped. Complete external-snapshot sections and co-located source material remain local; original hashes and ranges are preserved. Per-chain retention.json states the archived and local-only segments. Raw execution payloads remain local; audit summaries are explicit bounded derivatives.
independence: Independent initials share the frozen source packet. Confirmations use the original reviewer, its own report, the actual runtime delta and explicitly selected author responses and source evidence. Intermediate confirmations retain their raw verdicts and snapshot-specific acceptance; neither accepted nor unaccepted earlier snapshots are final acceptance of this revision.
limits: Bounded textual and host evidence, not native/device or arbitrary-pool acceptance.
